handle.title: Whisperwood Lever-Grip
handle.description: Carved from ancient Whisperwood. It wakes mechanisms that have not turned in a long age, and rarely survives the effort.

key.title: Chrono-Skeleton Key
key.description: Chrono-Smith work. It opens doors that time has locked, and fits yesterday's wards as though it were cut for them.

sword.title: Echoing Blade
sword.description: Forged where the fires went out long ago. It rings with battles nobody remembers, and wants one more.

potion_red.title: Phoenix Elixir
potion_red.description: Brewed from phoenix feathers. Crimson, faintly warm, and it gives strength back to anyone brave enough to drink it.

potion_green.title: Sylvan Essence Draught
potion_green.description: Distilled from Sylvan Grove essence. It lends the patience of old woodland, and tells you which growing things to trust.

book.title: Temporal Grimoire
book.description: A Chrono-Scribe's work. Its pages pull threads out of time and hand back spells that were meant to stay lost.

headtorch.title: Head Torch
headtorch.description: A miner's helm lamp, its beam narrow and honest. It follows wherever you look, and gutters when you land hard.

gems.title: Rubies
gems.description: Two cut stones, still warm from whoever carried them last. Worth a great deal to someone who is not down here.

solar_seal.title: Solar Seal
solar_seal.description: A gilded seal stamped with a rayed sun. Someone pressed it into a lid once and took it with them afterwards.

lunar_seal.title: Lunar Seal
lunar_seal.description: A pewter seal stamped with a waning moon. The twin of the sun seal, and colder to hold than the tunnels explain.

playerfirefly.title: Firefly
playerfirefly.description: A friendly firefly that orbits you through the dark.
